integrity: Mathematical proof supplies global optimality, with reproducible finite checks as corroboration; self-review only. The tree-covariance formula and general log-det framework are established tools, and formerly solved terminal-path examples overlap some special cases.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimum and conductances are proved for relative tree-edge price at or above the degree threshold, while the lower-price result proves only necessary deletion of some hub spoke. No independence or full prior-art completeness is asserted.
title: Sharp degree-controlled spoke deletion in determinant-optimal tree cones
